request: Turn off track changes and mark the files as final
summary: Each file opens with Track Changes off and marked as final (Word's Mark as Final: read-only with a 'Marked as Final' bar). Nothing in the document's text changes; pending tracked changes stay as they are.
assumptions: a file whose tracking is locked with a password is set aside (unlock it in Word first)
pending tracked changes are not accepted or rejected (that is resolve_tracked_changes, only when asked)
Mark as Final sets the custom property _MarkAsFinal and the Status property Final, as Word does; a file without custom properties gets them
